PASS 3 / FINAL BATTERY (B.md pass records 1-6; worktree inv/0f462p/b-final, base 132fa87, fresh .venv via uv, serial pytest, StageHarness threads=1; integrated into this branch's base at 4891dfa): quick 21 passed twice (20.48s / 20.36s, exit 0), discovery 14 passed with statistics (37.35s: enrollment nonempty 96.15%, overlapping raw spans 30.77%, B2 fan-out family drawn at 3.77%), deep 14 passed (57.62s), ruff clean, mypy 3 errors all pre-existing at 132fa87 outside B ownership; recorded in passes[] as pkg-b-pass2-* (B.md's manifest note: this section closes AUDIT-2's missing B pass-2 record; the campaign's pass-2 completion evidence is the final battery, which subsumes the integrated pass-2 correction). CURRENT PARITY PINS (witness repair, replaces the pass-1 strict-xfail references): tests/properties/test_pkg_b_enrollment.py::test_enrollment_overlapping_raw_spans_parity (positive pin with explicit B2 witness asserts: one dispensing, supply 46 > 30, numdispensing 2 > 1) + tests/properties/test_pkg_b_stockpile.py::test_stockpile_fanout_parity_on_overlapping_spans; detail in B.md Properties table.
